Ce plugin doit être approuvé par NeoDex: This plugin must be approved by NeoDex to open.
Choisis une pièce puis clique sur la gri: Choose a part then click the grid to place it. Drag a part to move it, drag from an output (right) to an input (left) to connect them. Click a switch: turn it on. Right click or Delete: remove a part or a wire.
Construis des circuits logiques à la sou: Build logic circuits with the mouse: switches, lamps, a clock and 7 gates (AND, OR, NOT, XOR, NAND, NOR, XNOR), joined by wires that light up when current flows. The truth table computes itself, latches keep their memory, and 5 examples show a half adder, a full adder, an SR latch, a multiplexer and a blinker.
Le circuit dessiné et la vitesse de l'ho: The drawn circuit and the clock speed.
Le circuit oscille (une boucle sans fin): The circuit oscillates (an endless loop): the table shows it with ~.
